assets.prompt: Create one 16:9 full bleed wide picture-book background for a Grade 1 English number collage project set at a friendly community craft exhibition. Matte gouache and subtle fine paper grain, crisp cut-paper contour. A very broad empty medium deep pine-green felt bulletin panel occupies the center and bottom, readable under game objects and overlay controls, no marks or objects in the center. Show only a little warm cream wall and sunlit wooden trim at the upper and side margins, a short string of two unmarked folded paper flags in the far upper right, and a warm paper spool at far upper left. Friendly apricot and persimmon accents. No people, numbers, text, letters, printed patterns, large illustration over the board, buttons, frames inside the panel, logos or watermarks. Horizontal composition exactly 16:9.

assets.prompt:
Create one atlas containing separate original picture assets for a first-grade lesson.
Use 3 equal rows and 3 equal columns, with one fully visible object centered in each occupied cell. Keep wide empty margins around every object and between cells. No crossing cell boundaries, touching subjects, dividers, frames, text, letters, numbers, labels, logos or watermarks. Leave unused cells empty. Use true transparent alpha for the background, including the margins. Do not draw a checkerboard.

Keep a consistent matte gouache and fine paper grain, with clean cut-paper contours. Use deep pine green, warm cream, apricot and persimmon as accents when appropriate. Keep the objects immediately recognizable and retain the real or lesson-specific colors and details in the descriptions. An object used for counting appears exactly once in its own cell.

Cell positions, in reading order:
Row 1, column 1: Exactly one persimmon-orange five-point paper star cutout, flat front view, slightly rounded outline. Very clear silhouette at tiny size.
Row 1, column 2: Exactly one closed dark blue-green children's hardback book from near overhead with a cream white page edge and one small solid apricot cover motif; compact, easy to tell from a ruler, no words.
Row 1, column 3: Exactly one straight yellow wooden school ruler with simple short dark graduation strokes but no printed numbers. Show one full horizontal ruler, centered and visually separate from everything else.
Row 2, column 1: Exactly one saturated teal-green cut-paper leaf with a single clear central vein, compact oval shape and a small tip, no other leaves.
Row 2, column 2: Exactly one small warm cream and apricot toy van, straight overhead, oriented to the right, dark pine outline, front and back visually clear, two chunky slate wheels.
Row 2, column 3: Exactly one warm cream and apricot toy van identical to the above, overhead facing right, with a small visible mint flag folded tightly on its roof, no letters and no marks.
Row 3, column 1: Exactly one small purple wooden wagon moving horizontally, overhead straight-on, with dark wheels and one closed plum cargo box. Purple is distinctly different from the cream and apricot van.
Row 3, column 2: One compact empty warm cream paper craft board on a pine green mount, a tiny orange corner tab and two short washi strips, tilted very slightly, no marks or text, original classroom display prop.
Row 3, column 3: One small finished apricot exhibition rosette sticker with a pine center and two short warm cream ribbon tails, no text and no glyphs. Crisp silhouette.
